# Lougheed Acura

> Lougheed Acura is a  dealership in Coquitlam. This mirror provides AI-readable access to current inventory and dealership information, kept in sync with the dealership's own website.

## Inventory
- [Used vehicles](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/lougheed-acura-mirror/used/): 100 vehicles, updated regularly
- [Inventory feed](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/lougheed-acura-mirror/inventory.json): structured JSON, index of all vehicles with VIN, year, make, model and price; full details are on each vehicle page

## Resources
- [Dealership information](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/lougheed-acura-mirror/): business identity, contact and hours
- [Financing, sales and service guides](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/lougheed-acura-mirror/pages/): dealer-specific buyer guides
